description: This file defines the Java annotation interface 'OpenmrsProfile' used to conditionally create beans based on OpenMRS version and modules.

classes.name: OpenmrsProfile
classes.description: A Java annotation interface used to specify profiles for conditional bean creation based on OpenMRS version and modules.

methods.name: openmrsPlatformVersion
methods.description: Returns the OpenMRS platform version for which the annotated class/profile is applicable. Defaults to an empty string.

methods.name: modules
methods.description: Returns an array of module names that make the profile applicable. Defaults to an empty array.
